basic_info.description: This is your amazing opportunity to make this beautifully remodeled and upgraded property your home; it's complete with tremendous curb appeal, a sunny deck and landscaped backyard, and attractive value-add space. With its charm and tasteful updates, this home features a gracious living room, classic fireplace mantle, and period details throughout a free-flowing layout.  The formal dining room is equipped with a wine fridge and custom-built bar counter that's perfect for any host or family's needs. The adjacent kitchen offers plenty of space with brand new appliances, cabinetry, and countertops. Both bedrooms and bath are generously sized. The laundry room and additional work and flex space at the rear of the home adds tremendous practical value to complete the upper level. The sun-drenched deck and yard is an entertainer's dream. Bonus space downstairs with a separate entrance offers even more options; perfect for more living space, multi-generational living, or rental income. The garage comfortably fits one car or can also be used for storage, a home gym, etc. Fantastic location near multiple public transportation lines and with easy access to freeways nearby for commuters. This is a thoughtfully remodeled gem with a blend of modern amenities, functionality, and convenience.
